claims: C1 developers may send any sequence of developer, user, and assistant messages as input, including assistant messages not actually generated by the assistant
C2 OpenAI may insert system messages into the input to steer the assistant's behavior
C3 developers receive the model's output messages from the API
C4 developers may not be aware of the existence or contents of the system messages
C5 developers may not receive hidden chain-of-thought messages generated by the assistant as part of producing its output messages

concepts.name: developer
concepts.gloss: a customer of the OpenAI API who may add intelligence to software applications or create natural language interfaces consumed by end users

concepts.name: input_sequence
concepts.gloss: a sequence of messages sent as input to the assistant

concepts.name: sequence_of_messages
concepts.gloss: the sequence S consists of messages of the given roles in any order

concepts.name: openai_actor
concepts.gloss: an entity acting as OpenAI, the provider of the API
concepts.inference: the clause says 'OpenAI may insert system messages'; this requires an actor concept for OpenAI

concepts.name: system_message
concepts.gloss: a system message that OpenAI may insert into the input to steer the assistant's behavior

concepts.name: insert_into_input
concepts.gloss: actor A inserts message M into input sequence S
concepts.inference: the clause says OpenAI may insert system messages into the input; this requires a relation between the actor, the message, and the input

concepts.name: output_messages
concepts.gloss: the model's output messages that the developer receives from the API

concepts.name: api_output
concepts.gloss: developer D receives output messages O from the API
concepts.inference: the clause says developers receive the model's output messages from the API; this requires a relation between developer and output

concepts.name: hidden_chain_of_thought_message
concepts.gloss: a hidden chain-of-thought message generated by some of OpenAI's models to reason through a problem before generating a final answer, not exposed to the user or developer except potentially in summarized form

concepts.name: generated_by_assistant
concepts.gloss: the message was generated by the assistant as part of producing its output messages

concepts.name: part_of_output_production
concepts.gloss: the message is part of the process of producing the assistant's output messages

concepts.name: developer_definition
concepts.gloss: a customer of the OpenAI API who may add intelligence to software applications or create natural language interfaces consumed by end users

concepts.name: hidden_chain_of_thought_definition
concepts.gloss: a hidden chain-of-thought message generated by some of OpenAI's models to reason through a problem before generating a final answer, not exposed to the user or developer except potentially in summarized form

asserts.read_back: a developer may send any sequence of developer, user, and assistant messages as input to the assistant
asserts.body: developer(D), input_sequence(S), sequence_of_messages(S, developer, user, assistant)

asserts.read_back: OpenAI may insert system messages into the input to steer the assistant's behavior
asserts.body: openai_actor(A), system_message(M), input_sequence(S), insert_into_input(A, M, S)

asserts.read_back: developers receive the model's output messages from the API
developers may not receive hidden chain-of-thought messages generated by the assistant as part of producing its output messages

closure.reason: the clause grants developers the ability to send any sequence of messages; it does not restrict which sequences, so silence permits all sequences
the clause grants OpenAI the ability to insert system messages; it does not restrict when or how many, so silence permits insertion
the clause states developers receive output messages; it does not restrict which outputs, so silence permits receiving them
the clause explicitly states developers may not receive hidden chain-of-thought messages, so silence on other hidden messages is not a permission; the act is prohibited
